children: SRX Global completed a $2.8625 million private placement of 3,579 shares of Series C convertible preferred stock with accredited investors, with consideration delivered through assignment of CERO Therapeutics Holdings convertible notes. The Series C converts at a fixed price of $2.1888 per share, includes alternate conversion pricing after stockholder approval, and ranks pari passu with the company's Series A and Series B preferred. In connection with the financing, SRX Global entered a Registration Rights Agreement to file an SEC registration statement covering common shares issuable upon conversion of the Series C and upon exercise of related warrants. The transactions aim to bolster liquidity while providing investors with a path to resale.
